# Help Translate the Isometric Island game
- Here you will find information how to do it:

![1. Obtain the JS canvas](Guide/Contribute.png)
- Take the language.js sketch 
- Copy it

![2. Adding your own language to the game](Guide/Contribute3.png)
- Rename the file into the language you want to translate my game to (for ex Romania -> Romania.js)
- Open the file in Visual Studio Code
- Edit the translation phrases 

![3. Send me the file ](Guide/Contribute2.png)

- You can choose to contribute to this project or send the file via mail for annonymus 

![4. Done](<Guide/Screenshot 2026-04-12 172405.png>)

- That is all you have to do, it helps a lot
